[[Pyrefiend]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 30 [[Slayer]] and level 25 [[Combat level|combat]].

Pyrefiends attack with magic-based melee, meaning armour that provides magic defence should be worn or [[Protect from Melee]] should be used with [[Prayer equipment]], alternatively [[Prayer flick]].

==Safespots==
Safespots can be done with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] attacks, or a [[halberd]]. Pyrelords can be [[Safespot]]ted shown below, by putting a tree between the player and a pyrelord. Because pyrefiends are 1x1 size monsters, they cannot easily be safespotted, unlike 2x2 pyrelords, and require obstacles that can be attacked over or pathing the pyrefiend to a safespot. They can also be [[Flinching|flinched]] while taking minimal damage.
